text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing statutory three-hour parking maximum on Paulson Road (south roadway) adjacent to south-west section of Green Hills Park be changed to a standing prohibition. The proposed amendment will discourage parking on both sides of the subject section of Paulson Road and will provide an unobstructed flow of traffic on the street.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the north side of Paulson Road (south roadway), between King George's Drive and a point 87 metres further north. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on the south side of Paulson Road (south roadway), between King George's Drive and a point 60 metres further north.
